units.source_text: "瞧，来了。

en.t: Look, it has come.

units.source_text: 行动来了。

en.t: Action has come.

units.source_text: 你不觉得你所喜欢的美的东西，是在认识的保护下贪睡的东西吗？

en.t: Do you not think that the beautiful things you love are things that sleep greedily under the protection of understanding?

units.source_text: 记得我曾谈过《南泉斩猫》的那只猫，那只无与伦比的美的猫。

en.t: Remember the cat from Nansen killing the cat, the one I once spoke about, that incomparably beautiful cat.

units.source_text: 两堂的僧侣所以相争，是因为他们认为要在各自的认识中保护、培育猫，让它美美地进入梦乡。

en.t: The monks of the two halls fought because they thought they had to protect and nurture the cat within their own understanding, and let it drift beautifully into sleep.

units.source_text: 南泉和尚是个行动者，他巧妙地把猫斩死，然后扔掉了。

en.t: The monk Nansen was a man of action; he skillfully cut the cat down and then threw it away.

units.source_text: 后来来了个赵州，他把自己的鞋顶在头上。

en.t: Later Joshu arrived, and he put his own sandals on top of his head.

units.source_text: 赵州想说的，就是这样的。

en.t: What Joshu wanted to say was precisely this.

units.source_text: 他还是懂得美应该是在认识的保护下人梦的东西。

en.t: He still understood that beauty ought to be something that enters dreams under the protection of understanding.

units.source_text: 其实，各自的认识，所谓各自的认识这种东西是没有的。

en.t: In truth, each person's understanding, this thing called each person's own understanding, does not exist.

units.source_text: 所谓认识，是人类的海洋，也是人类的原野。

en.t: What is called understanding is the ocean of humankind, and also the plain of humankind.

units.source_text: 它就是人类一般存在的状态。

en.t: It is the general state in which humankind exists.

units.source_text: 我以为他所想说的，就是这层意思。

en.t: I think this is what he meant to say.

units.source_text: 你现在要以南泉自居吗？……

en.t: Are you now going to set yourself up as Nansen?

units.source_text: 美的东西，你所喜欢的美的东西，是在人类精神中委托于认识的残余部分，残余部分的幻影。

en.t: Beautiful things, the beautiful things you love, are the remnants entrusted to understanding within the human spirit, the phantom of those remnants.

units.source_text: 就是你所说的为了忍受生的另一种办法的幻影。

en.t: They are the phantom of what you called another way to endure life.

units.source_text: 可以说，这种东西本来就是没有的吧。

en.t: You could say that such a thing never existed in the first place.

units.source_text: 虽然这么说，但是使这种幻影变得强有力的、并尽所能地赋予它以现实性的，仍然是认识啊。

en.t: Even so, what makes this phantom powerful and gives it as much reality as possible is still understanding.

units.source_text: 对于认识来说，美绝不是慰藉，而是女人、是妻子。

en.t: For understanding, beauty is by no means a consolation; it is a woman, a wife.

units.source_text: 不是慰藉。

en.t: It is not consolation.

units.source_text: 但这决不是慰藉的美，在同认识相结合中也许会产生出某种东西来，

en.t: But this beauty, which is certainly not consolation, may produce something as it joins with understanding,

units.source_text: 也许会产生出无常、梦幻、无可奈何的东西来。

en.t: it may produce something impermanent, dreamlike, and helpless.

units.source_text: 总会产生出某种东西来的。

en.t: In any case, it will produce something.

units.source_text: 人世间称为艺术的，正是这种东西。"

en.t: What people in this world call art is exactly this kind of thing.
